name: Pronated bodyweight pull-up
definition: Hang from a bar with a pronated grip and no assistance or added weight. Pull the torso upward toward the bar, then lower to the hanging start.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Hang from a bar with a pronated grip and no assistance or added weight.
value.movement: Pull the torso upward toward the bar, then lower to the hanging start.
value.finish: Return to the defined hanging-arm position.
value.range_of_motion: Use a repeatable upper landmark near the bar and a defined lower-arm endpoint; no kipping.
